relevance_note: Case report of one adult with PFAPA syndrome carrying a TNFAIP3 variant, tested with his family: 'Heterozygous variant in TNFAIP3 gene c.63A>T(p. I21 = ) was detected by genetic testing from the samples of the patient, his father and his sister'.
method_note: Read the whole paper (no tables, no supplementary section). A short Python script in my scratch directory assembled the JSON from values I chose; it only located each typed quote in the paper to copy its exact characters (thin spaces, U+2010 hyphens, fullwidth percent), and every span was then checked verbatim. Scope: the patient (TNFAIP3 variant carrier, diagnosed PFAPA syndrome, not HA20) plus three tested relatives: father and sister (variant carriers, 'without any discomfort') and mother (tested, no variant; no variant row). Labels: 'patient' (rule 5); relatives by rule 2. n_patients_reported = 1 counts only the symptomatic patient; father and sister are asymptomatic carriers. cohort_size_as_stated left null (no cohort). Variant printed five ways: 'c.63A>T (P.I21=)', 'c.63A>T(p. I21 = )', 'c.63 A>T(p. I21=)', 'c.63A>T (p. I21 = )', 'c.63 A > T (p. I21 = )' (with thin spaces); the Figure 1 legend form was used. variant_type 'other' because the authors describe it as 'making no difference in the amino acid composition of proteins' (synonymous; no matching enum). Inheritance 'inherited paternal' is read from the parental testing result (father positive, mother negative) plus 'the suggestion of heredity'; the paper never says 'inherited from the father' in words. The paper calls the variant both a 'novel TNFAIP3 mutation' and a 'variant of uncertain significance'. Contradictions/oddities: (1) Discussion says 'no skin changes', but the case presentation reports red papules on the left thigh and a herpes zoster rash; both rows emitted, checklist skin lesions set to not reported. (2) 'no recurrent vulva ulcer' is stated for a male patient; recorded as an excluded feature but, as a narrower ('recurrent') absence, genital ulcers checklist left not reported. (3) CRP printed as 'CRP7 0.30 mg/L ↑' (value appears garbled); recorded as printed. Checklist judgments: normal colonoscopy covers only the colon, so 'gastrointestinal ulcers or inflammation' left not reported; normal chest CT used to exclude interstitial lung disease; 'no ophthalmitis' excludes ocular inflammation; ANA/ANCA/anti-cardiolipin/anti-β2-GP1 negative excludes autoantibodies. Headache not counted as CNS involvement; single herpes zoster and COVID-19 episodes not counted as recurrent infections. Relatives' 'without any discomfort' recorded as one excluded row each but not used to exclude specific checklist items. Age '25-year-old' is the age at presentation in the case narrative, recorded as age at last evaluation; no age at diagnosis stated. Onset recorded only as 'adult-onset'. Country of origin not stated (sequencing platform 'MGI, China' is not the patient's origin). Antivirals for herpes zoster (foscarnet, cobamamide, acyclovir, calamine), ibuprofen and failed antibiotics are not in treatment_summary because of the five-span limit.
